description: Only the VecSnap card calls this. It starts a conversion and answers at once, so the card can show it.

preset.description: How to draw it. Leave it out for filled shapes (default). centerline draws each line of the drawing as one single line instead of an outline: for line art or a sketch when the user asks for centerline, single line or one-stroke paths, or for it to be drawn by a pen plotter, a Cricut pen, foil or a scoring blade. A filled logo stays filled, for cutting or engraving too, unless the user asks for single lines.
